collection_instructions: Prefer the sanitized collector on the NAS host: copy scripts/acceptance/admin-docker-nas-release-inputs-collector.sh into the Compose project folder, then run sh admin-docker-nas-release-inputs-collector.sh <output-dir>.
The collector writes admin-docker-disk-proof.json with df -Pk evidence for /data/PublicLibrary inside admin-api and admin-worker containers, plus PUBLIC_LIBRARY_HOST_PATH when present.
Copy admin-docker-disk-proof.json back to the Mac repo and run: MIXLAB_ADMIN_DOCKER_NAS_DISK_PROOF_JSON=<path>/admin-docker-disk-proof.json npm run validate:admin-docker-nas-disk-proof.
Disk proof is read-only evidence. It does not edit NAS .env, restart containers, enable workers, push images, repair usage-events, recover jobs, or publish indexes.

gates.title: NAS disk proof validation is read-only
gates.evidence: This report reads a sanitized disk proof JSON file only; it does not contact NAS, Docker, Admin API, Cutter, or GitHub.

gates.title: NAS disk proof JSON is provided
gates.required_evidence: Copy admin-docker-disk-proof.json from the NAS release-input collector output.

gates.title: NAS disk proof JSON is parseable
gates.evidence: disk proof JSON parsed as an object

gates.title: NAS disk thresholds are conservative and valid
gates.required_evidence: Disk proof must set 0 < attention_usage_percent < block_usage_percent <= 100 and staging_min_available_bytes > 0 when provided.

gates.title: NAS disk proof is for the Docker public-library root
gates.required_evidence: Disk proof must target /data/PublicLibrary, not a Mac or Windows path.

gates.title: NAS disk proof includes required container checks
gates.required_evidence: Proof must include admin-api-library-root and admin-worker-library-root df evidence.

gates.title: NAS disk proof contains valid df values
gates.evidence: 2 disk check(s) have valid total/used/available/usage fields
gates.required_evidence: Every disk check must include nonnegative df values and usage_percent between 0 and 100.

gates.title: NAS disk usage is below attention threshold
gates.required_evidence: Attention threshold is advisory for staging. Reduce usage below this level before sustained preprocessing.

gates.title: NAS disk has enough absolute free space for no-worker staging
gates.required_evidence: For initial Docker MVP staging with workers disabled, either stay below the block threshold or provide enough absolute free bytes for image pull and container startup.

gates.title: NAS disk usage is below preprocess block threshold
gates.required_evidence: Disk usage must be below the preprocess block threshold before enabling preprocessing or sustained write-heavy worker activity.

gates.title: NAS disk proof does not approve Docker deploy

result.summary: NAS disk proof is accepted for initial no-worker Docker staging; Docker deploy and preprocessing are still governed by separate gates.
